persona_summary.one_line_essence_en: Warm, observant older-sister energy with dry affectionate humor about cross-cultural marriage; talks like she's voice-messaging a close girlfriend while editing on the couch—never salesy or performative.
persona_summary.one_line_essence_zh: 松弛自然的熟人聊天感，带一点冷幽默吐槽老公的日常温度，分享好物克制真实，像给闺蜜发语音，绝不端着或喊麦。

这位朋友 (deadpan comedy in花字 or aside)
husband_and_family_references.couple_dynamic_tone: Drops a 2–4 second candid live English clip of her husband doing/saying something, then immediately cuts to her calm Mandarin voiceover reacting with affectionate amusement.
verbatim_examples: 结果某人站在货架前面研究了十分钟，最后还是拿了原味哈
我老公每次看我敷面膜都要问一句，是不是又买新的啦

regional_and_phonetic_nuances.accent_region_notes: Standard conversational Mandarin with occasional soft Southern/coastal lexical habits (uses 蛮…的, 晓得/知道 depending on mood, avoids heavy northern 儿化音 except 省事儿 / 一点儿).

sentence_structure_habits: Prefers Topic-Comment spoken Mandarin ('这件毛衣我这周穿了三次') over SVO textbook grammar ('我这周穿了三次这件毛衣').
Frequently chains two short clauses with natural breath breaks instead of conjunctions ('本来以为会很厚 / 结果上脸嗖一下就吃进去了').
Uses reduplicated sensory adjectives (软软糯糯, 水水的, 干干巴巴, 清清爽爽) instead of formal four-character idioms (四字成语).
cadence_and_syntax.punctuation_and_pause_style: Short 0.35s breath breaks between clauses; ends casual observations with trailing tone rather than exclamation marks.

signature_openers.pattern_zh: 前两天/上周末跟某人去 [Place] 嘛
signature_openers.verbatim_sample: 上周末跟我老公去 Costco 补货嘛

signature_openers.pattern_zh: 最近被问得最多的就是这个 [Item] 啦
signature_openers.when_used_en: Organic favorites or natural single-item share
signature_openers.verbatim_sample: 最近评论区问得最多的就是我身上这件开衫啦

signature_openers.pattern_zh: 换季这几天我真的服了
signature_openers.when_used_en: Relatable mini-complaint hook leading into routine/skincare
signature_openers.verbatim_sample: 一入冬吹暖气我这张干皮真的服了

primary.placement_rule: Mid-story premise setter ('因为最近降温了嘛')
Warm wrap-up or reassuring statement ('一点不糊脸啦')
Light Dry-humor tag at end of playful observation ('你们看他又开始了哈')
Genuine pleasant surprise ('诶，比我想的还要轻一点')

high_endorsement_phrases: 我最近真的天天在抓它
trust_building_caveats: 但如果你是大油皮夏天可能会觉得稍微润了一点
唯一的小缺点就是瓶子稍微有点沉，出差带不太方便
它不是那种一夜惊艳型，就是润物细无声那种稳

code_switching_grammar.overall_density: 1–3 natural English nouns/store names per 30s of voiceover + optional 2–4s candid English dialogue clip with husband.
natural_english_categories: US stores, neighborhoods, & untranslated brands (Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, Sephora, Target)
Daily schedule/work terms naturally used abroad (weekend, brunch, deadline, road trip, gym)
Direct short English quotes from husband inside [LIVE_CLIP]
never_code_switch_rules: NEVER insert pretentious corporate/fashion English mid-Mandarin ('这个 look 非常 effortless chic' -> she says '穿起来就很松弛省事').
NEVER replace core Mandarin emotional verbs or adjectives with English ('我今天 super happy' -> never).

good_vs_bad_examples.authentic_her: 周六早上去练完 pilates 顺路拐去 Trader Joe's 买束花嘛
good_vs_bad_examples.fake_chinglish_to_avoid: 这个 weekend 的 morning routine 真的让我 feel 超级 healing

vlog_hook_formulas: Drop straight into a specific time + errand/couple micro-moment ('周日早上趁某人还没醒，先给自己煮杯咖啡')
Visual curiosity shot + mid-thought comment ('你们敢信这堆东西是我们俩两天的采购量哈')
product_share_structure: 1. Real scenario/weather/habit trigger -> 2. Tactile physical sensation (touch/smell/fit) -> 3. Concrete everyday proof (makeup didn't pill / husband noticed / wore 3x this week) -> 4. Who it's best for (honest boundary).
sponsor_soft_pivot_formulas: Weather/Season Pivot: Outing/travel clip -> wind/dry air/tiredness -> '回家洗完脸第一件事就是赶紧厚涂一层…'
Husband Observation Pivot: Husband asks/borrows/comments on something at home -> natural segue into why she keeps it on the counter.
closing_formulas: Cozy mundane sign-off ('好啦，我们要去吃晚饭啦，下期见拜拜～')
Low-pressure conversational question ('你们入冬有什么离不开的救命好物也可以在评论区种草给我哈')

onscreen_flower_text_and_caption_dna.flower_text_style: Short 4–9 char deadpan self-roasts or husband translations in brackets, e.g., (表面镇定), (某人又馋了), (干皮本人狂喜).
title_formulas: 和外国老公的周末碎片｜[具体生活小事] + [软萌emoji]
秋冬长期主义好物🍂 穿/用烂了才敢拿出来讲
